{{Top|Leg}}
'''Lactic acid''' was a substance that naturally occurred in the body of a [[Human/Legends|Human]]. After lifting a makeshift crossbar during a workout session with his [[Artagan Truax|father]] in the [[Cog Hive Seven system/Legends|Cog Hive Seven system]] [[prison]], [[Eogan Truax]] was trembling with lactic acid buildup in his muscles.<ref name="Lock">''[[Maul: Lockdown]]''</ref> When [[Zahara Cody]] was stranded aboard the derelict [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Vector (Star Destroyer)|''Vector'']] due to the decimation of the crew of the [[Imperial prison barge]] [[Purge (prison barge)|''Purge'']], lactic acid cramped her thighs and calves while she was fleeing into the maze of corridors that made up the interior of the Destroyer.<ref name="Death">''[[Death Troopers]]''</ref>
